display_long_description:
Somos Huella VR invites you on an unprecedented spiritual and technological journey. Immerse yourself in the historic "Path of Juan Diego" and relive the profound apparitions of Our Lady of Guadalupe through a highest-quality 360° cinematic virtual reality experience.

This application has been designed with a special focus on accessibility, with seniors as our primary audience. Our goal is for technology not to be a barrier, but a bridge to faith. Therefore, we offer a simple experience that is intuitive from the very first use, requiring minimal manual interaction.

Experience Features:

Deep Immersion: Enjoy a highest-quality 360° video production with a duration of approximately 40 minutes.

Zero Complications: Automatic video playback upon launching the application. Just put on the headset and your spiritual journey begins!

Smart Sensors: The system features automatic pause when removing the headset and automatic resume when putting it back on, allowing you to take breaks without losing the thread of the story.

Integrated Accessibility: An optimized 360° video player that includes easy-to-use toggle options for subtitles.

Clean Design: A minimal and clear interface, intended for non-technical users and designed specifically to avoid distractions.

Join this story of faith, hope, and love. Feel the company of Our Mother Mary face-to-face, in a peaceful, safe, high-quality technological virtual environment.
